failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh's checkpoint/cleanup and plan-generation subprocess mocks are producing a truncated or malformed jq output ('Invalid numeric literal'), causing downstream stage-artifact checks (plan.md, review.md) to be skipped/missing and cascading into the full E2E, resume, complexity-skip, and cleanup test failures
failures.fix: Fix the mock plan/RL-episode JSON emitter to output valid JSON (quote/escape the reward or complexity numeric fields) so jq stops erroring, then re-verify plan.md/review.md artifact creation in the mocked pipeline stages

failures.fix: Re-check the pipeline's failure classification logic — likely a false-positive trigger (e.g. matching on stray output or a prior transient error) rather than a real test regression; verify against the actual exit code and rerun the suite
